content: अवधारण {%a.%} Restrictive, limiting. .{@-णम्, -णा@} .²1 Ascertainment, determination; मान˚ <ls>Dk. 161</ls>. .²2 Affirmation, emphasis. .²3 Limitation (of the sense of words); यावदवधारणे, एवावधारणे; मात्रं कार्त्स्न्येऽवधारणे <ls>Ak.</ls>; तुरत्रावधारणार्थः .²4 Restriction to a certain instance or instances to the exclusion of all others. .²5 Taking up, expressing, reciting (a name); न त्वां देवीमहं मन्ये राज्ञः संज्ञावधारणात् <ls>Rām. 5. 33. 10</ls>.
